native_loss_rate.source: Observed 2022 native cohort outside current mapped TI and integral UC union, common valid 2023–2025 coverage; recomputed national quintiles

formulas.context_and_opportunity: S1 remains national cumulative mass of absolute cattle counts. S2 uses equal-municipality quintiles of low-plus-medium vigor pasture share.
formulas.conditions: Conditions = 200 times the product of the observed factors S3/100, S4/100 and mean(observed S5,S6)/100. Omit an unavailable factor; report how many of S3 to S6 are observed. If all are missing, the result is missing.
formulas.risk: Risk points = 5 times the mean of observed scores S7 to S11. Higher points mean lower observed pressure. Report component coverage; missing components can change comparability.
formulas.S11: Inverse equal-municipality quintile of 100 * existing administrative embargo hectares / matched municipal territory hectares in BR_BDC_2. Unknown overlaps and declared hectares without usable polygons remain; this is an administrative ratio, not deduplicated spatial coverage. Missing administrative area stays missing.
formulas.S7: S7 = inverse national quintile of 100 × mean annual first official native-vegetation loss 2023–2025 / observed 2022 native stock, both outside the union of mapped Indigenous lands and integral-protection conservation units and using the same pixels observed in all three years. Recomputed national cuts; larger rates receive lower notes.
formulas.S10: S10 = cumulative mass (Pareto) of identified terms in descending order: 0 to 20% receives 20, above 20 to 40% receives 40, above 40 to 60% receives 60, above 60 to 80% receives 80, above 80% and zero terms receive 100. Team sheet of 21 October 2026.
formulas.opportunity: S2 score from existing municipal percentage; missing share remains missing.
formulas.S2: 100 * low-and-medium-vigor pasture hectares / mapped pasture hectares; observed municipal percentages scored by unweighted national quintiles.
formulas.S8: Inverse equal-municipality quintile of ind08_scored_ratio_pct, outside Pampa; hectares retained as context; no minimum with an area subscore.
formulas.S9: Inverse equal-municipality quintile of pressao_floresta_publica_pct in mapped OPGT footprint; hectares retained as context; no minimum with an area subscore.
formulas.S7_whole_context: 100*(first official native loss 2023–2025 from the fully observed native 2022 cohort /3)/same fully observed native 2022 stock, whole municipality; outside TI/integral UC remains the active S7 score.

adaptations: The Word risk table has ambiguous direction. Inverse pressure scores preserve its stated risk meaning. This adaptation requires method acceptance.
Drought uses observed historical HDF as a proxy; S4 = 100 - HDF. Annual extent and cumulative exposure remain unavailable.
HDF coverage is diagnostic under the existing owner-approved no-coverage-gate rule. Do not reintroduce the Word 80% coverage threshold.
Distance retains the validated mesoregional pixel rule. National scoring comparisons do not replace this geographic distance benchmark.
Public forest uses observed conversion as a proxy for the unavailable union of all suppression and conversion.
No final typology is produced, following Word comment 1 and the launch workbook Version 2.
Support uses national empirical Q20/Q40/Q60/Q80. Each band includes its lower limit, as in Table 10 of the methodology.

Historical owner decision of 5 November 2026, already incorporated in the current topic formulas. Observed components are used and their coverage is reported. In conditions, an unavailable multiplicative factor is omitted, equivalent to 1, as stated in formulas.conditions. Risk uses five times the mean of observed S7–S11 scores. This note introduces no separate override. Credit and association results remain supplementary.
S2/S8/S9/S11 now use municipal percentage references with equal municipality weights; absolute hectares remain contextual. Explicit zero and missing rules apply.
